findings.body: The local branch is checked against the receipt only at line 37, before checks.wait, which can wait 600 seconds (src/forge/checks.py:29). If someone commits locally during that wait without pushing, GitHub correctly merges the recorded head, but the newer local worktree is clean. This cleanup then removes it and force-deletes the branch containing the unmerged commits. Revalidate the local head before removal and preserve the worktree and branch if they advanced.
findings.title: Preserve local commits created while checks are running

findings.body: When codex.archive fails, Forge prints a warning but still deletes the ready receipt or marks it tidied and returns success. For a clean item, its worktree was already removed, so another forge merge cannot retry the outstanding archives; for a dirty item, forge next hides it despite unfinished archiving. Thus a temporary Codex failure permanently abandons the required archive work. Preserve a usable retry path and outstanding conversation IDs until all recorded conversations have been archived.
findings.title: Not done: 5. Complete archiving before retiring merge cleanup

findings.body: The assertion's 'failed' match comes from the unrelated 'FAILED stub diagnostic' emitted during every read (tests/stubs/codex-app-server:53), not the archive warning. Replacing the failure warning with a success message containing 'archive' would still pass, so this does not prove item 7's failure-reporting requirement. Assert the specific archive-failure message and its recovery instruction, independently of the reader's output.
findings.title: Not done: cold-read archive-failure reporting test
